# netskopebwan_address_object (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated from the provider's schema: the arguments this object requires, with
# placeholders to fill in. Remove these two lines to maintain the example by hand.
# A single object is addressed either by its id...
data "netskopebwan_address_object" "by_id" {
  group_id = "6501f0c2e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6"
  id       = "6501f0c2e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6"
}

# ...or by a filter, which has to match exactly one object.
data "netskopebwan_address_object" "by_filter" {
  filter   = "name eq \"example\""
  group_id = "6501f0c2e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Address Group ID

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Filter selecting the object to read, in the API's filter syntax, e.g. `name eq "corporate"`. It has to match exactly one object. Exactly one of `id` or `filter` is required.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the object to read. Exactly one of `id` or `filter` is required.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Address of the Address Object
- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--created_by))
- `group_ids` (List of String) GroupIds associated with the Address Object
- `modified_at` (String)
- `modified_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modified_by))
- `name` (String) Display name of the Address Object
- `segment_id` (Number) SegmentId of the Address Object
- `site_id` (String) SiteId of the Address Object
- `tags` (List of String) Tags associated with the Address Object
- `tenant_id` (String) TenantId of the Address Object
- `type` (String) Type of the Address Object Must be one of: `ipv4`, `ipv6`, `mac`.
